news.title: Police ask for help for man accused of nabbing iPhone from store counter
news.summary: Henry County police are asking for the public’s help identifying a man accused of taking an unattended iPhone 14 from a RaceTrac in McDonough.

news.title: East Point police offer anonymous way to report crime, safety concerns
news.summary: The East Point Police Department is reminding residents they can anonymously report suspected criminal activity and neighborhood safety concerns through its tip411 service.

news.title: K-9 dies after escaping out-of-state training facility
news.summary: The Dunwoody Police Department is mourning the loss of Ranger, one of its first K-9 officers, after he escaped an out-of-state training facility and was later found dead.

news.title: 13-year-old struck after gunfire hits SE Atlanta apartment
news.summary: A 13-year-old boy is recovering in the hospital after gunfire pelted an Atlanta home early Sunday morning, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: 13-year-old shot 4 times overnight in Atlanta; mother says it’s not his first time being shot
news.summary: An Atlanta teenager was shot four times early on Sunday morning.

news.title: Police investigating overnight shooting in SE Atlanta
news.summary: The victim was alert, conscious, and breathing at the time of transport

news.title: 4 men wanted after stealing refrigerator from Atlanta home, APD says
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public's help to identify four men caught on home surveillance video walking into a home in broad daylight and allegedly leaving with a refrigerator.

news.title: Clayton deputies arrest 11, seize drugs during street patrols
news.summary: Clayton County deputies arrested 11 people and confiscated an illegally modified handgun alongside illicit drugs during street patrols over the past week, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: Felon admits to firing shots, burying gun in southwest Atlanta: police
news.summary: A felon was arrested early Monday morning after admitting to firing shots in a southwest Atlanta parking lot and burying a handgun in nearby woods, according to the police.

news.title: 2 arrested in Illinois for deadly northwest Atlanta shooting, police say
news.summary: Two suspects, including a 15-year-old, were arrested in Illinois this week in connection with a deadly summer shooting of a 33-year-old man in northwest Atlanta, police announced.

news.title: Police investigating two separate shootings in South Atlanta
news.summary: Police have detained a possible suspect. Aggravated assault investigators also responded to determine the circumstances around the shooting.

news.title: Possible suspect detained after 2 injured in Atlanta shooting: APD
news.summary: A possible suspect has been detained after gunfire left a man and a woman injured in Atlanta on Saturday afternoon, according to the Atlanta Police Department.
